title: Over The Gear
description: Over the Gear is a cute game about jumping gear teeth. You're a guy named Cog, and you fell into a clock or a factory, somehow (I'm as clueless about the story as you are), and now you have to avoid your impending doom by not touching the gear's teeth. As you progress, you meet cool friends as Cog traverses wherever he is. This will not be explained in-game in any way, shape, or form.

title: Scriblr (Legacy)
description: Scriblr is a decentralized hub for writers, publisher and readers where you hire and be hired, read and be read, find and be found. Where Books, articles, scripts and other content are ranked on generic quality.

title: Omlit
description:
A frontend mockup for a site about food conservation and dealing with starvation. Omlit is a solution to the problem of food wastage. where someone in your local area puts up food that is currently in excess
or of no use to them for sale. From breakfast to lunch, if it is edible, it can be sold on omlit
which provides income for the seller on food that would have been wasted

title: Gladys
description: Gladys is a text-based, choose-your-own-adventure game played entirely in your terminal. Step into a world where your choices are the only thing that matters. Every decision branches the story into new directions—some leading to success, and others to an untimely end.

title: Julz Beauty & Fashion Store
description: A simple fashion store site made for a client. It's just to showcase location and contact information while being elegant and functional also showcasing services

title: Usiju Event Centre
description: A booking and showcase side made for an event center. It incorporates beautiful design and functionality with its intricate booking system. It also uses resend to send emails to user to inform them about important info. It is well made and shows expertise and style.

title: Genie
description: This is a simple online ide for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It allows for instant testing and provides a simple workspace for writing code and viewing the output immediately

title: Mist
description: A weather app made with the OpenWeather API to display the realtime weather of various cities around the world.

title: Ellipsis: a calm place for busy minds
description: Ellipsis is a second brain notes app that allows you to capture the half-formed ideas, reminders and fragments that show up throughout the day. Ellipsis figures out how they connect, and brings back the ones worth finishing.
